TanStack Router context in beforeLoad.description:
Add a value to the context every child route and loader receives; what beforeLoad returns is merged into the inherited context. Insert as a route option inside createFileRoute.

向所有子路由与 loader 可见的 context 中补充值，beforeLoad 的返回值会并入继承来的 context；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。

TanStack Router useRouteContext.description:
Read one value out of the route context. Requires the Route exported by the route module.

从路由 context 中读取单个值；需要该路由模块导出的 Route。

TanStack Router runtime context (TypeScr.description:
Declare a context value at router creation and supply it at render, for anything that only exists once React is running. Requires createRouter and RouterProvider from @tanstack/react-router.

在创建 router 时声明 context 项、在渲染时再注入，适用于只有 React 运行后才存在的值；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRouter 与 RouterProvider。
